# OrganicAI homepage media guide

The repository currently contains no homepage video binaries. The page uses `/images/organicai-hero-human-ai-bg-v2.png` as a complete poster fallback.

| Filename | Purpose | Ratio and resolution | Crop | Format and accessibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organicai-home-hero.webm` | Primary cinematic loop | 16:9, 1920×1080, 8–18 seconds | Human subject within centre/right safe region | Compressed WebM; decorative, muted |
| `organicai-home-hero.mp4` | Browser fallback | 16:9, 1920×1080 | Match WebM | H.264 MP4; no embedded text or audio dependency |
| `organicai-home-hero-mobile.webm` | Optional portrait loop | 3:4 or 9:16, 900×1200 or 720×1280 | Keep subject centred | Compressed WebM; poster remains mandatory |
| `organicai-home-hero-poster.webp` | Critical poster | 16:9, 1920×1080 | Match first video frame | WebP, decorative background |

The video should depict a calm organic-futurist Human + AI journey, avoid flashing content, aggressive robots, surveillance imagery, stock-office footage, and text embedded in the frames.
